design.excluded_reason: The request specifies two hourly FX periods and original weekly/daily tasks. Overlapping full-prefix and extra weekly retrospective periods are not additional independent evaluations. E6 fixed-lambda paths are exploratory tuning candidates, not complete selected forecasting procedures in this comparison inventory. All remain in old archives; no outcome-based exclusion.
design.core_method_id: family::method, within declared comparison identity; preserve full source-qualified label unless the explicit F/I semantic alias rule below applies.
design.semantic_alias_rule: Only the named matchedF aliases, and separately matchedI aliases, may be merged to canonicalF/I when complete origins, capacities, targets and loss vectors are exactly equal. Record every alias. If claimed aliases differ, retain every source-qualified procedure with an explicit discrepancy; never choose a favourable version or average them.
design.one_state_class: original::one_state_F/S/K condition on a query-nearest single-state subpool, so they are conditional state baselines, not the full-window matched F/I historical rule.
design.conditional_class: All remaining non-F/I procedures, including feature QR/KNN, query-nearest one-state baselines, QRF/FHS/SAV, selectedR0-R3, finite ACI wrappers and already published fixed combinations. A procedure selecting infinity or producing an identical forecast is not reclassified ex post as historical.
design.unavailable_slots: Retain all12 inherited NA/FAILED selected-method slots and48 previously reported unavailable panel-median combination slots. They have no complete loss vector, enter no bootstrap and are not counted as statistically excluded. Never score a partial vector or rerun a forecast.

combinations.implementation: Unchanged v6_combinations.combine_reports: meanF/2+originalQR/2; median np.median(np.stack((F,originalQR,plainKNN)),axis=0). Use original matched frozenF/QR constituents; panels originalQR33, not QR33plus or QR4. No missing KNN substitution.
combinations.restriction: Recover only previously COMPLETE published rows on the original56source/H/W contexts. Reconcile recovered aggregate loss with its unchanged published scores/mean_loss within existing1e-12absolute +2e-14relative arithmetic tolerance; failed reconciliation makes whole comparison FAILED_INPUT, not a new combination result. No new weights, models or periods.

design.loss: Use complete stored per-point pinball when available; derive only missing loss from saved complete peak/capacity by unchanged v6_inference.pinball_losses(tau=.95). Do not fit, select or issue a new financial report. Keep all private old input/derived vectors in .scratch; publish hashes/aggregate MCS only. CFTC vectors are already public.
design.floor_boundary: No missing QR4/Levy floor recovery in E3: their stored loss/target/capacity suffices. Preserve missing floor/reference metadata for the separately registered E4. Existing stored floors may be used for validation and published deterministic combinations; no cost/headroom/excess averages here.
design.alignment: Every claimed COMPLETE method must have its exact full declared origin axis, finite/nonnegative full loss, finite capacity/target, and exactly identical target/origins to every other method in that comparison. No intersection, truncation, imputation, rescaling, crossperiod merging or partial-prefix mean. File/hash/shape/target disagreement in a claimed complete input makes the whole comparison FAILED_INPUT. Known inherited NA slots remain explicit and do not prevent comparison of the complete methods.
design.loss_equivalence: After semantic aliases, collapse only exact np.array_equal full loss columns for the library call; representative is lexicographically first method ID. Preserve groups and unfold inclusion and p-values to every distinct procedure label. Distinct conditional selection rules/combinations remain distinct ex ante even when forecasts/losses coincide.
design.all_equal_case: One unique full loss column: analytic identical-loss set containing every procedure, p=1, with statusCOMPLETE_IDENTICAL_LOSSES; do not feed a one-column matrix into arch. Zero valid methods=>UNAVAILABLE. Single complete method=>analytic singleton with explicit count, no inferential discrimination claim.
design.block_rationale: Fixed cube-root heuristic bounded below by label horizon; accommodates local overlap. Not selected using any MCS result and not claimed optimal.
design.method_column_order: lexicographic full method IDs after semantic alias handling; fixed independently of loss ranking
design.membership: Use arch included/excluded/pvalues properties literally; version8 usesPvalue>size for included and<=size for excluded. No manual boundary adjustment.
design.failure: One library attempt per complete comparison. RuntimeWarning, exception, nonfinite/out-of-range p-value, incomplete membership partition, timeout or resource failure =>MCS_FAILED for that whole comparison. Keep error/diagnostics and inventory, no retry, alternate statistic, block length, bootstrap or favourable subset.

report.primary_historical: Canonical/qualified matchedF/I only, from the explicit alias lists above; rolling primary controls remain in the model set but their broader historical membership is reported separately.
report.historical_membership: fraction of successful comparisons whose unfolded set contains any matchedF/I procedure
report.historical_unique: fraction whose unfolded set has exactly one distinct procedure and that procedure is matchedF/I; semantic duplicate storage aliases do not count as distinct procedures
report.historical_unique_equivalence: secondary fraction with exactly one surviving exact-loss class containing matchedF/I; this may still contain indistinguishable conditional labels and is not the primary literal uniqueness claim
report.historical_only: secondary fraction whose nonempty unfolded set is entirely matchedF/I
report.conditional_exclusion: excluded conditional distinct-procedure slots divided by conditional complete-procedure slots in successful MCS comparisons; inherited failed/NA procedures are inventoried separately, not counted as statistical exclusions
report.failed_denominators: Always show successful/planned comparisons and failed cells. In addition to successful-denominator fractions, publish all-planned lower/upper bounds obtained by treating failed comparisons (or their conditional slots) as unknown, never as favourable outcomes.
report.interpretation: Descriptive fractions across related, overlapping tasks, no independent-source pooled test or family-wide across-cell coverage guarantee. Stationary-bootstrap approximation on inspected/replayed data does not establish future risk coverage, causal frequency effects or actual economic value.

design.code_seal: Commit artificial-tested adapter/wrapper/driver before source materialization/statistical run; seal numerical code, design commit, source inventory and private/public file hashes before the sole MCS launch. Report-only table derivations may follow without numerical rerun.
